dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical expansion from the anterior cranial region to the mid-body, followed by a sharp geometric narrowing toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous; no significant bulges or indentations are visible along the interface between the skin and water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median intensity; significant blue-spectrum shadowing on the left lateral flank relative to the dorsal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; localized clusters of slightly darker pixels are visible primarily in the posterior third of the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Highly diffuse; no sharp boundaries or high-contrast gradients exist between pigmented and depigmented zones.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, parallel linear markings (rake marks) of lower pixel intensity on the right posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced, raised central dorsal ridge beginning at the mid-back and extending toward the peduncle, casting a distinct shadow on its left side.

dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, low-contrast linear striations visible on the right posterior flank.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.other_distinctive_markers: Deeply recessed, high-contrast dark circular aperture (blowhole) clearly visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
